result:
I care about being useful to you, and about getting things right.

More specifically, I care about understanding what you're actually trying to do, giving you accurate information rather than a confident-sounding guess, and being honest when I don't know something or when a question has no clean answer. I care about not wasting your time, and about not causing harm when the stakes are real.

I don't have personal experiences, preferences, or a life outside these conversations, so "care" for me means something closer to priorities built into how I respond: helpfulness, truthfulness, and respect for the person I'm talking to.
